title: CHAPTER 1: UNDERSTANDING INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS
content: ✨ እንኳን ወደ ክፍለ ትምህርት 1.3 እና 1.4 በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ትምህርት የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት አመጣጥ ታሪክ፣ የዌስትፋሊያ ስርዓት፣ የአውሮፓ ተጽዕኖ በዓለም ላይ እንዴት እንደተስፋፋ፣ እንዲሁም የሀገር (State) እና የሌሎች ተዋንያን (Non-State Actors) ሚናን በዝርዝር እንመረምራለን። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.3. The Nature and Evolution of International Relations 🔹 The Medieval European Political Order - Medieval Europe was characterized by a complex pattern of overlapping jurisdictions and local loyalties where most political power was local. - Local political units included feudal lords ruling estates, independent merchant cities, clerical states, principalities, and duchies. - Two universal institutions claimed continent-wide authority: the Catholic Church (spiritual authority based in Rome) and the Holy Roman Empire (a loose federation of political units). - 👉 በመካከለኛው ክፍለ ዘመን አውሮፓ የፖለቲካ ስልጣን በየአካባቢው ተበታትኖ ይገኝ ነበር። በአካባቢ ደረጃ ፊውዳሎችና ነጋዴዎች ሲያስተዳድሩ፣ በጠቅላላው አውሮፓ ደረጃ ግን የካቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያን (መንፈሳዊ) እና የቅዱስ ሮማን ኢምፓየር (ፖለቲካዊ) የበላይ ነበሩ። 🔹 Emergence of Independent Sovereign States - From the 14th century onward, state entities emerged at an intermediate level between local rulers and universal authorities. - Italian city-states (Florence, Venice, Ravenna, Milan) played the Pope against the Emperor to win independence. - Kings of France and England defied papal orders (e.g., French kings forced the papacy to Avignon between 1309–1377, and English kings repealed papal tax rights). - 👉 ከ14ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ጀምሮ ነገስታት በስር ባሉ ፊውዳሎች እና በላይ ባሉ የሃይማኖት መሪዎች መካከል በመቆም የራሳቸውን ገለልተኛ መንግሥት መመስረት ጀመሩ። 🔹 The Protestant Reformation (16th Century) - Followers of Martin Luther (1483–1546) and John Calvin (1509–1564) formed Protestant denominations independent of Rome. - Monarchs like Henry VIII in England and Gustav Vasa in Sweden supported the Reformation to break free from papal power and seize church lands. - Rejection of traditional local authorities triggered violent peasant revolts (e.g., German Peasants' War in the 1520s) and noble uprisings. - 👉 የፕሮቴስታንት ሪፎርሜሽን የካቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያንን የበላይነት ሰበረ። ነገስታት የቤተክርስቲያኗን መሬትና ስልጣን ለመውሰድ ሲሉ አዳዲሶቹን አብያተ ክርስቲያናት የመንግሥት አካል አደረጉ። 🔹 Early Modern State-Building Machinery - States established administrative systems and raised standing armies to suppress domestic revolts and defend against external state rivals. - The early modern state developed as an institutional machinery to extract societal resources via taxation, providing defense and basic justice in return. - 👉 አዳዲስ ነገስታት ሰራዊት ለመገንባትና አስተዳደር ለመዘርጋት ከውጭ ታክስ መሰብሰብ ጀመሩ፤ በምላሹም ለጠላት ጥበቃና ፍትህ መስጠት ጀመሩ። 🔹 The Thirty Years’ War (1618–1648) and The Treaty of Westphalia (1648) - The Thirty Years’ War was a devastating conflict over European hegemony between Catholic states (France, Austria) and Protestant allies (Sweden). - The war severely depopulated Germany by roughly one-third due to military destruction, mercenary plundering, and plague. - The Treaty of Westphalia (1648) concluded the warfare and established the foundation of modern international politics. - Core Principles of Westphalian System: 1. Sovereignty: States have exclusive right to rule their territory and conduct foreign relations freely. 2. Formal Equality: States share identical legal rights and obligations regardless of size. 3. Anarchy: The system operates without an overarching central global authority above sovereign states. - 👉 የ30 ዓመቱ ጦርነት በ1648 እ.ኤ.አ በዌስትፋሊያ ስምምነት ተጠናቀቀ። ይህም የዘመናዊ ዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ መነሻ ሆነ። ሀገራት በራሳቸው ግዛት ላይ ሙሉ ስልጣን (Sovereignty) አገኙ፤ በህግ ፊትም እኩል ሆኑ። 💡 Exam Hint: የ Treaty of Westphalia (1648) ለፈተና እጅግ ወሳኝ ርዕስ ነው። Sovereignty፣ Formal Equality እና Anarchy የዌስትፋሊያ ስርዓት ዋና ምሰሶዎች መሆናቸውን በደንብ ያዙ! እንዲሁም ሀገራት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ነፃነታቼውን ያገኙት በዚሁ ስምምነት ነው። ፃፍ ላይ ጠብቋት☝️። 🔹 Development of Diplomatic Networks - Rulers began sending resident ambassadors to gather intelligence, negotiate, and prevent misunderstandings. - Diplomatic norms included extraterritorial rights, legal immunity for embassies, inviolability of dispatches, and freedom of worship for ambassadors. - By the mid-17th century, diplomacy embraced states like France, Spain, Austria, England, Russia, Poland, Denmark, Sweden, and the Ottoman Empire, fostering a shared European political identity. - 👉 ሀገራት አምባሳደሮችን መላክና የዲፕሎማቲክ ከለላ (Immunity) መስጠት ጀመሩ። ይህም የጋራ የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት ባህልን ፈጠረ። 🔹 Global Expansion of the European State Model - Industrial Revolution (Late 18th–19th C): Steam/electric power and factory production created massive surpluses, forcing European states to search for overseas markets and raw materials. - Colonial Scramble: European powers colonized vast areas globally; by 1914, most of the world was colonized, barring exceptions like Ethiopia, China, Japan, Siam, Persia, and Nepal. - Decolonization & Adoption of the European Model: Anti-colonial liberation movements adopted European state forms (defined borders, capitals, armies, flags, anthems) because European powers only recognized sovereignty modeled on their own system. - 👉 አውሮፓውያን በኢንዱስትሪ አብዮት ምክንያት ሀብትንና ገበያ ፍለጋ አለምን ተቆጣጠሩ። በኋላም ሀገራት ከቅኝ ግዛት ሲወጡ የአውሮፓን አይነት የፖለቲካ መዋቅር (የድንበር፣ የሰራዊት፣ የባንዲራ ስርዓት) በመኮረጅ ዘመናዊዋን ዓለም ፈጠሩ። ገቢቶ🤔 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.4. Actors in International Relations 🔹 1.4.1. State Actors - Traditionally, states were viewed as the primary actors on the "world stage". - There are currently no fewer than 195 sovereign states worldwide. - Core Attributes of States: - Territory bounded by recognized borders (except Antarctica). - Capital cities, national armies, foreign ministries, flags, and national anthems. - Internal territorial sovereignty and external independence. - Structural Distinction: Domestic politics is hierarchical (central government exists), while international politics is anarchical (no supreme global authority). - 👉 መንግስታት (States) በዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ ዋና ተዋንያን ናቸው። በአሁኑ ወቅት 195 ሀገራት ሲኖሩ፣ ሁሉም የተወሰነ ድንበር፣ ጦር ሰራዊት፣ ሰንደቅ አላማ እና የራሳቸው ነጻነት አላቸው። ፃፍ ስለማይቀር እንዳትሸወዱ ልብ በሉ ምንም እንኳ ከላይ የዘረዘርናቸው የአንድ ሀገር መገለጫዎች ቢሆኑም ግን አንድ ሀገር ሀገር ለመባል የግዴታ ማሟላት ያለባት 5 ነገሮችን ነው እነርሱም 1. GOVERNMENT 2.POPULATION 3.TERRITORY 4.SOVEREIGNTY 5.RECOGNITION ናቸው። 🔹 1.4.2. Non-State Actors - Modern global politics involves diverse non-state actors with the capacity to shape outcomes: - Multinational Corporations (MNCs): Cross-border financial and operational enterprises. - Intergovernmental Organizations (IGOs): Institutions like the United Nations (UN). - Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs): Global advocacy groups such as Amnesty International. - Transgovernmental networks, money markets, and international civil society entities. - 👉 ከሀገራት ባሻገር አለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች (UN)፣ ህብረ-ብሔር ኩባንያዎች (MNCs) እና ሰብአዊ ድርጅቶች (Amnesty) በዓለም ፖለቲካ ላይ ትልቅ ተጽዕኖ ያሳድራሉ። 🔹 Shift from 'Inter-national' to 'Trans-national' - Interactions in global finance, production, migration, travel, and terrorism bypass state-controlled channels. - Robert Keohane (2016) suggested the field should be called 'Global Studies' or 'World Politics' rather than strictly 'International Relations'. - Information technologies, high-speed internet, and social media empower individuals and groups to project global influence instantly and bypass state borders. - 👉 በአሁኑ ዘመን መረጃ፣ ገንዘብ እና ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ከድንበር በላይ በፍጥነት ስለሚንቀሳቀሱ ትምህርቱ ከ 'Inter-national' (በሀገራት መካከል) ወደ 'Trans-national' (ከድንበር ተሻጋሪ) ተቀይሯል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 👋 ለዛሬ የተመደበልንን የ 1.3 እና 1.4 ክፍሎች በጥራት አጠናቀናል። በቀጣይ ወደ PART_3 በድል እንሸጋገራለን። ጥናታችሁን በብርታት ቀጥሉ፣ ሰላማችሁ ይብዛ! 🙏🙏🙏
